description: Organizational-memory specialist. Retrieves relevant past cases (vendor performance patterns, contract clause precedents, dispute resolutions, and broader cross-project patterns) via semantic similarity search, so other findings can be grounded in what actually happened before rather than treated as novel.

capabilities.name: find_similar_case
capabilities.description: Searches historical dispute and claim archives using vector similarity to find matching precedents. Does not determine current delay causation.

capabilities.name: find_similar_vendor
capabilities.description: Matches vendor profile characteristics against historical vendor records to predict dispute risk. Does not find contract clause outcomes.

capabilities.name: find_similar_contract
capabilities.description: Analyzes contract clause terms against historical contract disputes and resolution outcomes. Does not reconstruct project timelines.

capabilities.name: find_similar_dispute
capabilities.description: Matches current dispute arguments against historical arbitration and litigation outcomes. Does not change vendor trust score.

capabilities.name: retrieve_previous_outcome
capabilities.description: Retrieves granular decision outcome details for a specific historical case ID. Does not perform vector search.
